name: All-bold single grotesque
description: Faces: one grotesque, every size bold; a squared, engineered grotesque of the kind used on signs and instruments suits it as well as a plain one. Display at 700-800 in mixed case, 48-64px (3.3-4.4vw at 1440), leading 0.86-1.0, tracking -0.01em; then 40 / 32 / 24px, body at 600-700 and 16-20px (leading 1.35), small text 14-15px at the same weight in sentence case. Ratio about 3x, so hierarchy cannot come from weight or size: it comes from filled cards that group each head with its lines, from ground contrast and from position. Sentences stay under 14 words and paragraphs at two or three lines; long bold text tires the eye. Colour: ground pale neutral, concrete grey or deep neutral, ink at full contrast, one accent (a warning-like amber, green or red-orange suits it) as a card fill, the button and key figures, never a coloured word in a headline. Motion: heads cut in with a short 160ms slide or step in as a block with a 16px rise; link hover swaps ink for the accent. A 48-64px headline does not fill the first screen alone, so the hero carries a large picture or window.
phone: Display 34-40px, body 16-18px at the same weight, measure 30-34 characters, leading opened by 0.05; cards stack full width.
houseRuleCheck: A page only of boxes is banned: deal it with picture sections between the card sections.

name: Ultra-tight black caps poster word
description: Faces: one grotesque with a 900 weight for the headline and its regular cut for text. The headline is one to three words in black caps at 11-17vw (160-245px at 1440), leading 0.84-0.9, tracking -0.06 to -0.1em, tightened until the letters almost touch but never overlap. Text is the regular cut at 16-18px, tracking -0.02em, leading 1.35; controls and small text the same face in sentence case at 15px, weight 500. Ratio 13-19x: a poster-scale word and ordinary text with nothing between. Colour: ground a flat saturated colour or a deep neutral, ink at full contrast, accent on the button only. Motion: the word eases from scale 1.0 to 0.94 as the section leaves; links flip fill on hover.
phone: Word stacked on two or three lines at 20-24vw so no line is wider than the screen minus the margins; text 16px.
houseRuleCheck: No monospace and no decorative accent word: the poster word is a content word, never a giant name in the footer, and controls are sentence case.

name: Black condensed poster over serif text
description: A black (900) condensed grotesque in capitals for one poster word at about 27vw over a transitional serif that carries the reading text, with a plain sans for controls. The poster word is about 385px at 1440, leading 0.9, one word or two short words stacked so they fill the content width inside the margins; set as live text stretched with scaleY or a width axis, never as drawn paths. Serif text at 30 / 26 / 20 / 18px, tracking -0.03em, leading 1.1-1.4, carries about 60% of what is read; controls are the sans at 16px, weight 600, sentence case. Ratio about 19x. Colour: ground flat bold or deep neutral; the poster in full-contrast ink or in the accent, the serif in a softer ink. Motion: the poster rises from below its baseline as the section enters and the serif text scrolls across it; controls swap fill on hover.
phone: Poster 38-42vw on two stacked lines (about 150px) so it spans the width; serif 20 / 18px; controls 16px.
houseRuleCheck: The poster word is live text and a content word, never a giant name in the footer; controls are plain sans in sentence case, no monospace.

name: Black grotesque heads, regular body
description: Faces: one grotesque with 400 and 900 cuts. Heads in black (900), mixed case: 100px for the hero and 72px (5vw) for section heads at 1440, leading 0.9-1.0, tracking -0.02em. Body 400 at 16-18px, leading 1.45. Buttons use weight 600 at 18-22px so their labels are the second strongest thing on the screen. Ratio about 6.3x. The contrast is between black and regular, with nothing in between: no 700 or 800 steps. Keep heads to three or four words. Colour: ground bright or flat dark, ink at full contrast, the accent as button and card fill. Motion: heads slide in 40px from the left with opacity, 90ms apart; hover shifts the button fill.
phone: Heads 40-44px and 36px, body 16px, buttons full width at 18px.
houseRuleCheck: Clean.

name: Bold caps giant, plain UI
description: A bold (700) grotesque in capitals for the display over an extended sans at 500-600 for navigation, buttons and the rare paragraph. Display at 11.5vw (165px at 1440), leading 0.84, tracking -0.02em, one or two lines. Nothing sits between the display and the interface: no mid headings. Links and buttons at 16px, weight 600, sentence case, no tracking; a paragraph is rare, one 20px line at leading 1.35. Ratio about 10x. Colour: ground flat colour or a neutral, ink at full contrast, the accent on one filled button. Motion: the display splits per word and each word rises 40px, 60ms apart; link hover changes colour.
phone: Display 16-17vw so the longest word fits (60-66px); interface 16px; buttons 48px high.
houseRuleCheck: The interface type is 16px sentence case, never small tracked capitals.

name: Bold caps neo, caps lead
description: Faces: one neo-grotesque at 700 with a 400-500 for small text. Display in 700 caps at 8.6-10.4vw (124-150px at 1440), tracking -0.03 to -0.06em, leading 0.8-0.95, no more than two lines per statement. The lead, and short body blocks of up to three lines, stay in bold caps at 18-30px, leading 1.1, no tracking; middle heads in mixed case 700 at 44-56px. Everything under 18px (captions, form hints, legal lines, small buttons) is sentence case at 15px or more, so caps never sets small text. Ratio 5-8x: a voice that shouts in short lines and explains in quiet ones. Colour: flat bright or deep ground, ink at full contrast; the accent appears as card fills and the button, never recolouring part of a headline. Motion: display lines cut in from the bottom through a clip, 70ms apart, the lead 200ms after; links invert ink and ground on hover.
phone: Display 15-17vw capped so the longest word fits (about 56-62px); lead 20px caps; body 16px sentence case; one column.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals only at 18px and up, untracked; anything smaller is sentence case, and a caps statement stays within three lines.

name: Bold geometric heads
description: Faces: a geometric sans at 700 for headings and 400 for text; a neutral grotesque at 13-14px for fine print is optional. Heading ladder 74 / 46 / 40 / 28 / 24px (5.1vw at the top at 1440), leading 1.0 at the top easing to 1.4, tracking 0: round letters need air, so no tight tracking. Body 17px at leading 1.55. Ratio about 4.6x. The round bowls give a friendly voice; keep headings in mixed case, short, one to three lines. Colour: ground cream, white or a saturated tone, ink deep navy or black, the accent a warm or green tone on the button and a card fill. Motion: headings rise 20px with a soft ease, 80ms apart; card hover brightens the fill.
phone: Ladder 38 / 30 / 26 / 22 / 20px, body 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Clean.

name: Bold humanist heads, tight
description: Faces: one humanist sans with 400 and 700 (open apertures, a little stroke contrast). Headings in 700, mixed case, at 82 / 46 / 37px (5.7vw at the top at 1440), tracking -0.035 to -0.043em, leading 1.1; body 400 at 16px, leading 1.5; small text 14px, leading 1.8. Ratio about 5x. The tight tracking suits humanist letters; keep headings to one or two lines. The voice is approachable and capable. Colour: ground warm white or a soft tinted neutral, ink deep neutral, one organic mid-tone accent on the button and card fill. Motion: headings fade in during 500ms; links change colour on hover.
phone: Headings 42 / 30 / 26px at tracking -0.03em; body 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Clean.

name: Bold tight grotesque at large scale
description: Faces: one grotesque or neo-grotesque at 400 and 700; a second plain sans at 500 for small text is optional. Display in 700 at 9.7-11.7vw (140-168px at 1440), tracking -0.03 to -0.05em, leading 0.78-0.85, on a ladder of about 128 / 94 / 57 / 33px; body 400 at 17px, tracking -0.02em, leading 1.4; small text 14-15px at 500 in sentence case. Ratio 8-9x. The leading is so tight that lines nearly touch: check that descenders (g, y, p) clear the ascenders of the next line and open the leading to 0.85 where they collide. Keep headlines to one or two lines of four words or fewer. Colour: ground off-white or ink-black, ink at the strongest contrast, accent confined to one filled button and one card fill. Motion: lines rise out of a mask 60ms apart; hover on links changes colour only.
phone: Display 14-16vw (56-64px) if the words are short, else 12vw; ladder 56 / 40 / 28 / 22; body 16px; leading opened to 0.9.
houseRuleCheck: No monospace and no condensed accent word: the small voice is the body sans at 14-15px, sentence case.

name: Bold title-case serif poster
description: Faces: one transitional serif with 400 and 700; no sans anywhere. Display in 700 title case at 15vw (216px at 1440), one or two words only; then 104 and 84px in title case, leading 1.1, tracking -0.01em; body 400 at 20px, leading 1.38. Ratio about 11x. Title case, not caps; emphasis comes from weight, never italics inside a headline. Colour: ground paper or deep ink, ink at strong contrast, one saturated accent on the button or a card. Motion: the display scales from 1.0 to 0.9 across the first screen of scroll and slides up; hover lightens or darkens ink.
phone: Display 20vw on one or two words (about 78px); steps 52 / 40px; body 18px.
houseRuleCheck: No italics inside a headline; the display is a content word, never a giant name in the footer.

name: Caps didone over caps sans
description: A didone at 400 in capitals for every heading over a clean neo-grotesque or geometric sans at 400-500 that also sets navigation, buttons and short text in capitals. Headings run 100-120px at 1440 (7-8vw), leading 0.9-1.0, tracking -0.03em, then 46 and 30px; keep the top step at 64px or more so the fine strokes survive, and nothing in mixed case in the headings. The sans sets navigation, buttons and short blocks (three lines at most) in capitals at 17-21px, tracking no wider than +0.02em; longer paragraphs and anything under 17px stay in sentence case at 16-17px. Ratio 5.5-8.5x: a fully capitalised, formal voice. Colour: ground bone or deep ink, ink opposite, one muted accent on the button and a card fill. Motion: headings reveal line by line with opacity and a 24px rise, 90ms apart; nav links shift ink toward the accent on hover.
phone: Didone caps 13vw (about 50px) on short words so the thin strokes hold; sans caps UI 16px; long text sentence case 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals in the sans only at 17px and up with at most +0.02em; long text and anything smaller in sentence case.

name: Caps didone, light sans body
description: A didone at 400-500 in capitals for the display over a light-to-regular neo-grotesque (300-400) in mixed case for everything read. The display runs 70-180px (5-12.6vw at 1440), one size per section rather than every size at once, leading 1.0, tracking -0.02em, with a capitals middle step in the display face near 24px. Body 16-17px at leading 1.5; labels and captions in the same sans, sentence case, 14px, no tracking. Ratio 5-7x: the display is the show and the body quiet and airy. Colour: ground ivory, stone or a deep neutral, ink at soft contrast, accent a muted metal-like or deep tone on the button only. Motion: the display eases from scale 1.06 to 1 with opacity in 900ms as it enters, line by line; hover softens ink slightly.
phone: Display 11-13vw (44-52px); middle step 20px caps; body 16px at leading 1.55.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals only in the display and the 24px middle step; labels are 14px sentence case, untracked.

name: Caps top step, mixed-case statements
description: Faces: one grotesque at 500, with a bolder cut for short small lines. Only the top step is caps: 8.3vw (120px at 1440), leading 0.8-0.9, tracking -0.01em. Below it, statements in mixed case at 46px (leading 1.1), a large body at 30px (leading 1.1-1.2) that reads like a statement itself, a 22px h3, and 18px bold sentence-case small lines. Ratio about 4x. The page speaks in short big sentences, so each section holds one statement and little else. Colour: ground warm neutral or saturated, ink at full contrast, the accent as card fills and the button. Motion: statements reveal word by word at 30ms; hover lifts ink toward the accent.
phone: Top step 13vw (about 52px) caps; statements 30px; body 22px; bold small 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals only on the 120px top step.

name: Regular caps display stack
description: Faces: one normal-width sans at 400-500; the same family in sentence case sets text at 16-18px. Everything large is caps on a deep stack of five or six display sizes between 5vw and 22vw (72-317px at 1440). Never more than three of the sizes in view at once: the hero word fills the width at 20-22vw, section titles run 8-12vw, sub lines 5vw. Leading 0.8-1.0, tracking 0 to -0.01em. Ratio 10-19x. Text stays small and plain so the stack reads as scale, not as shouting. Colour: ground one flat saturated hue or off-white, ink black or white, accent on the button and a card fill. Motion: on scroll the giant word steps down the stack (22vw to 12vw) as the next section covers it; hover changes ink only.
phone: Stack becomes 18vw / 12vw / 8vw / 6vw; every display word fits on one line, so pick words of seven letters or fewer for the hero.
houseRuleCheck: The giant hero word is a content word and never comes back as a giant name in the footer.

name: Small flared-serif caps, no display
description: A flared serif (stroke ends widen slightly) in capitals at 32px over a grotesque for navigation, buttons and small text, with no display step: the type tops out at 32px, so large pictures, cards and space carry the page. The display face sets the 32px heads (tracking -0.04em, leading 0.9) and 18px sub-heads in capitals; the grotesque sets navigation and buttons in capitals at medium weight, 15px, untracked, and running text in mixed case at 16px. Ratio about 2x. Every screen needs a big picture or a filled card group to make rank, because the type will not; the hero is a full-screen picture with the 32px line set on a quiet area of it. Colour: ground pale stone or deep neutral, ink one step off full contrast, one muted accent on the button. Motion: nav items shift ink on hover; headings fade in during 500ms.
phone: Serif caps 26px and 16px, grotesque 15-16px; same faces, one column.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals at 15px and up, untracked, so no letter-spaced labels. Deal it only with picture-led sections, since no display step fills the first screen.

name: Caps grotesque, didone second voice
description: A grotesque at 400 in capitals for the display, the menu list and the body over a didone, also in capitals, as the second voice for section heads. The sans sets the display at 105px (7.3vw at 1440), a full-screen menu list at 64px and short lines at 18px; the didone sets the 53px section heads. Everything big is capitals at leading 1.0; running text is the sans at 16px in sentence case. Each headline is wholly one face; the two never mix inside a headline. Ratio about 7x. Colour: ground bone or deep ink, ink opposite, one muted accent on the button. Motion: menu lines stagger in 60ms apart; hover shifts a line 12px right and tints it with the accent.
phone: Display 12vw (about 47px), menu list 34px, heads 30px, body 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Each headline uses one face only (a second face inside a headline is an accent word); capitals at 18px and up, running text in sentence case.

name: Caps sans line above a caps serif line
description: Two display lines in capitals, a bold (700) humanist sans line above a transitional serif line, over a geometric sans at 400 for text. Line one at 8.2vw (118px at 1440), tracking -0.03em, leading 0.9; line two at about 112px directly under it, matched to the same width so the pair reads as one block. Each face keeps its own line; the two never mix within a line. Text at 16-17px in sentence case, leading 1.5. Ratio about 7x. Colour: ground deep or pale, ink at full contrast, accent on the button only. Motion: the two lines enter from opposite sides by 30px and meet in place in 700ms.
phone: Both lines at 11vw, wrapping at word boundaries; text 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Each face keeps its own line, so there is no accent word; no tracked caps tagline or label, and no decorative glyph face.

name: Caps old-style ladder, extended text
description: An old-style serif at 400 in capitals for every heading over a wide-set grotesque at 400-500 for the text. Heading ladder 144 / 96 / 72 / 56 / 40 / 24px (10vw at the top at 1440), tracking -0.064em at the top easing to -0.01em at 24px, leading 0.83-1.0. Text in the wide grotesque in sentence case at 16px, leading 1.5; wide letters read larger, so 16px does the work of 18. Ratio about 9x. Colour: ground parchment or a deep tone, ink at contrast, one accent on the button and card fills. Motion: headings reveal line by line with a 0.4em slide; links tint on hover.
phone: Top step 15vw (about 58px), then 40 / 30 / 24 / 20; text 16px, one column.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals only in headings, 24px and up; text in sentence case.

name: Small condensed black over extended text
description: A condensed black (900) grotesque in capitals for heads at only 3.8vw over an extended grotesque at 600-700 that carries about 90% of the text. The display is 55px at 1440, leading 0.85, tracking 0, with a 23px step; the extended text runs at 16px, sentence case, weight 600, tracking 0. The contrast is width, not size: narrow heavy heads against wide small text. Ratio about 3.4x. The page has no giant type, so the hero is a full-screen picture or window with the headline set on a quiet area of it. Colour: ground off-white or dark, ink at full contrast, the accent as card fill and button. Motion: heads reveal through a 180ms mask; hover inverts a link.
phone: Heads 36px, 20px step, extended text 16px; one column.
houseRuleCheck: The extended text is 16px sentence case, never small capitals.

name: Condensed caps as seasoning over neo text
description: A condensed grotesque at 500 in capitals, used sparingly (about 4% of the characters), over a neo-grotesque for everything else. The condensed display is 5.3vw (76px at 1440), leading 1.0, tracking 0, only for the first-screen headline and the section headings. The neo-grotesque's display cut at 500 sets the 20-24px sub-heads, and its text at 400-500 runs at 16px, leading 1.5. Ratio about 4.8x. The condensed face is a seasoning, never the body. The headline does not fill the screen alone, so the hero carries a picture or window. Colour: ground neutral, ink at full contrast, the accent on button and card fills. Motion: heading words stagger 50ms up from the baseline; link hover tints.
phone: Condensed 36px (10vw), sub-heads 20px, text 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals only in the condensed display; all text in sentence case.

name: Condensed caps poster, rounded display word
description: Faces: one condensed grotesque in capitals for almost everything, plus one bubbly, soft-cornered decorative display face for whole standalone words. The poster word is 30-35vw (432-504px at 1440), kept inside the page margins, with a second size at 15vw (216px), leading 0.78-0.85 so stacked lines nearly touch without their glyphs overlapping. Labels at 40px capitals, body at 26px and controls at 19px (+0.025em) in the same condensed family. The decorative face covers about 12% of the type as whole words or one line on its own, never a word inside a headline. Ratio about 17x. Colour: saturated ground, ink in strong contrast, the decorative word in the accent. Motion: the poster drifts with a slow parallax of about 0.15; the decorative word scales 1.0 to 1.03 on hover.
phone: Poster 40vw stacked on two or three lines (about 150px); labels 28px; body 20px; controls 17px.
houseRuleCheck: The decorative face sets standalone words only (inside a headline it would be an accent word); the poster word is never a giant name in the footer.

name: Condensed poster with editorial voices
description: A condensed grotesque in capitals for the poster at 22vw over three supporting faces, each with one job: a geometric sans in capitals for the h2 and big labels, a light old-style serif for story text and a light neo-grotesque for fine print. The poster is 322px at 1440, leading 0.8, then 160px; the geometric capitals run 56-64px; the serif story text 38px at leading 1.25; fine print 16px. Ratio about 20x. The jobs are shout (condensed), name (geometric capitals), tell (serif) and annotate (small sans); never swap them. Colour: ground dark or paper, ink at contrast, the serif in a softer ink, the accent on the button. Motion: the poster word pins for one screen while serif story lines rise through it; hover shifts colour.
phone: Poster 30vw (about 117px); geometric caps 34px; serif 26px; fine print 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals only at 56px and up; the poster word is never a giant name in the footer.

name: Condensed caps at every step
description: Faces: one condensed grotesque at 500 in caps for every display step: 150 / 140 / 120 / 95 / 80 / 64px (10.4vw at the top at 1440), leading 0.8-1.2, tracking 0. Text at 17-18px in the same family in sentence case, since small condensed caps are hard to read. Ratio about 12.5x. A single narrow family means the stack can set several lines of different sizes into one poster block; keep the stack to three sizes per section. Colour: ground flat, ink at full contrast, one accent on the button and card fills. Motion: on scroll the block steps down to the next size in the ladder; hover changes colour only.
phone: Top step 15vw (about 58px), steps 40-52px; text 17px.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals only in the display; text in sentence case.

name: Decorative caps display, plain UI
description: A decorative display face with real character (inline cuts, quirky terminals or flared stems) in capitals over a grotesque at 300-400 for everything small. Display at 8.4vw (121px at 1440), leading 0.83, tracking 0 to -0.02em, one display line per section so it stays an event, not a texture. Status lines and interface text are the grotesque at 16px, weight 400, sentence case, leading 1.4. Ratio about 7.5x. Colour: ground deep or paper, ink at contrast, the accent on the button. Motion: letters settle in with a 20ms stagger; hover shifts ink.
phone: Display 12vw (about 47px), wrapping at word boundaries; text 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Small text is 16px sentence case, never small tracked capitals; no ornament glyph stands in as a drawn shape.

name: Loose-leaded didone over neo
description: A didone at 400 in mixed case for the display over a neo-grotesque at 400 for body and labels; no capitals, no italics. Display at 7.6vw (110px at 1440) with open leading of 1.38 so the lines float apart; follow-on steps at 78 and 72px at leading 1.05; body at 24px, large and calm; labels and captions at 20px, sentence case. Ratio about 4.6x. Keep the display to one or two short lines, because open leading lets each line stand alone. Colour: ground ivory or a deep tone, ink at soft contrast, the accent muted and rare. Motion: lines fade up 150ms apart in 900ms, slowly; hover warms ink a little.
phone: Display 11vw (about 43px) at leading 1.3; steps 34 / 30px; body 20px.
houseRuleCheck: Clean.

name: Compact didone, sans body, book-roman notes
description: A didone at 400 for the display and sub-heads over a neo-grotesque at 500 for the body, with a small book roman with serifs as a quiet third voice for notes. Display in mixed case at 5vw (72px at 1440), leading 1.0; sub-heads in the display face's capitals at 30px (-0.04em) and 21px quotes; body in the sans at 16px (-0.02em, leading 1.4); captions and notes in the book roman at 14px, sentence case, no tracking, or in the sans when the page keeps to two faces. Ratio about 4.5x from display to body, with the steps above the body close together (72 / 30 / 21px). Quiet and magazine-like: type never leads, so pictures carry the screen and the hero is a full-screen picture with the 72px headline on a quiet area of it. Colour: ground paper or stone, ink soft black, the accent muted, on the button only. Motion: sub-heads rise 12px, quotes fade; nothing loud.
phone: Display 38px; sub-heads 24px caps; body 16px; notes 14px.
houseRuleCheck: Notes are 14px sentence case, untracked; capitals only in the 30px sub-heads.

name: Extended black caps, one family
description: Faces: one wide extended grotesque at 900 for display and the h3, and 500 for controls and text. Display at 9.6vw (138px at 1440, leading 0.92) and 88px, caps; the h3 in 900 caps at 28px; controls in 500 caps at 18-56px depending on the button size; body and small text in sentence case at 16px, weight 500. Ratio about 9x. Extended letters are wide: a 138px line holds about seven letters across a 1260px measure, so headlines are three words or fewer and short words. Colour: ground flat bold or near-black, ink at full contrast, the accent on the button. Motion: letters stagger in 25ms apart from a 24px offset; hover shifts a button's fill.
phone: Display 10-11vw (about 40-44px), words of eight letters or fewer; controls 18px; body 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals only at 18px and up with at most +0.015em; body and small text in sentence case.

name: Light extended caps, compact scale
description: Faces: one extended grotesque (wide letterforms, wide set) carries every tier, all in capitals and all untracked. Display at 400, 48px at 1440 (3.3vw, lh 1.1), one to three lines of at most 22 characters, max 880px wide. Text at 600 and 16px (lh 1.45, at most 38 characters a line because the face runs wide), never smaller and never more than two sentences in a block; buttons, captions and list items use the same 16px 600, so the hierarchy comes from the change from 400 to 600 and from ink strength (display full, text 72%), not from size jumps. Ratio about 3x: a calm, compact scale that leaves the pictures and the space to do the talking. Colour: ground a flat pale stone or a flat deep tone, ink the opposite pole, the accent one flat hue only as the fill of the single action. Emphasis is a whole line, never a word inside a headline. Motion: display lines rise out of masks 80ms apart (700ms, ease-out-expo), once; link hover fades the ink to the accent in 160ms.
phone: Display clamp(26px, 7.2vw, 48px) on at most four lines; text 16px capitals with lines of at most 28 characters; same weights and ink steps.
houseRuleCheck: Nothing under 16px and nothing tracked; capitals only in blocks of at most two sentences, and no decorative accent cut.

name: Heavy extended heads, plain extended text
description: One extended-width grotesque family in two weights, no second face. Hero line: mixed case 800 at 150px at 1440 (lh 0.9, -0.03em), at most two lines of 12 characters, set on the left page margin. Section heads: capitals 800 at 40px (lh 0.95, -0.02em, max 760px, one to three lines of at most 20 characters); card and sub heads: capitals 800 at 20px (lh 1.05). Body: 400 at 16px (lh 1.5, max 46 characters, 82% ink on pale grounds, 70% on dark); small text 14px sentence case 400, never capitals. Ratio about 9x from hero to body and 2.5x from head to body, so the weight and the width do the work, not a long ladder. Colour: ground a flat warm white or a flat deep tone; ink the opposite; accent one saturated flat hue for the primary button fill and one large figure, never a headline word. Motion: heads rise out of masks line by line, 70ms apart, 700ms, once; link hover fades the ink to the accent in 160ms.
phone: Hero clamp(40px, 11vw, 56px) on at most three lines; heads 26px; sub heads 18px; body 16px with lines of at most 30 characters.
houseRuleCheck: Small text is 14px sentence case, never small capitals; the hero line is plain text, not logo art, and never a giant name in the footer.

name: Margin-to-margin extended caps word
description: One extended grotesque, weight 800, capitals. The headline is a single word of four to nine letters fitted to the full content width: the viewport minus the side margins (1344px at 1440 with 48px margins, about 93vw), never 100vw, so it never touches an edge. The size is computed, not guessed: measure the word at 100px with canvas text metrics, scale it to the width and recompute on resize; that gives about 215-250px at 1440 for six letters, lh 0.85, -0.01em, one line. Under it after 40-64px: a lead at 20px, weight 300 extended, -0.025em, lh 1.5, max 520px at 70% ink, and small text at 14px sentence case 500. Use the word where the page needs one loud idea, such as the hero (the word on the bottom margin of the 100svh screen, the lead and the action at the top left) or a mid-page statement. Colour: flat ground, one ink, the accent only on the action fill. Motion: letters rise out of a mask one by one (40ms apart, 800ms, ease-out-expo); on scroll the word lifts 6% while the lead fades out within the first 40% of the screen height.
phone: Word fitted to the viewport minus 40px (about 62px for six letters); over eight letters it breaks into two fitted lines, never under 48px; lead 17px.
houseRuleCheck: The word stops at the page margins, never at the screen edge, and is a content word, never a name or email in the footer.

name: Bold geometric caps, compact
description: One geometric sans (circular bowls, single-storey a, even strokes) in 700, capitals at every tier, untracked. Hero 62px at 1440 (4.3vw, lh 0.9, max 840px, one to three lines of at most 24 characters), section head 54px, sub head 24px (lh 1.05), lead 20px, body and all labels and buttons 16px (lh 1.4); there is no 14px tier, so nothing small is in capitals. Body in capitals runs at most two lines of 36 characters at a time; longer reading goes in sentence case at 17px 500. Ratio about 3.9x. Colour: ground a flat strong hue (signal yellow, red, cobalt) or a flat pale tone, ink near-black or white as the contrast needs, accent a second flat hue on the single action only. Motion: heads rise word by word out of masks (60ms apart, 600ms); link hover inverts the label in its own 44px-high rounded rectangle, ink fill and ground letters, in 180ms.
phone: Hero clamp(34px, 9.5vw, 62px); head 34px; sub head 22px; body 16px with lines of at most 28 characters.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals at 16px and up, untracked, in short blocks only; longer reading in sentence case.

name: Geometric flat heading ladder
description: One geometric sans, 400 only, mixed case. A nearly flat heading ladder at 1440: 57px, 51px and 44px (4vw, 3.5vw, 3vw; lh 1.05-1.1, -0.04em), a lead at 19px and body at 18px and 16px (-0.02em, lh 1.4). Step ratio about 1.13, whole scale about 3.6x. With so little size difference the hierarchy is carried by position and ink (h1 and h2 at full ink, h3 at 70%, lead at 80%) and by filled cards that group things. Headlines run 18-26 characters a line, max 760px. Colour: ground a flat off-white tinted toward the palette or a flat deep tone; ink the opposite; accent one flat hue for the action fill. Motion: heads rise line by line out of masks (60ms apart, 700ms); hovering a card swaps its head to the accent in 160ms.
phone: Heads 32 / 30 / 28px at lh 1.1; body 17px and 16px; tracking kept; cards stack in one column.
houseRuleCheck: Grouping comes from filled cards, never outlines, and the page is not boxes only.

name: Caps serif poster, jump to text
description: A transitional serif at 400 in capitals for one poster word at 22vw, and in sentence case for one h2, over a neutral neo-grotesque for everything read. The poster word is 320px at 1440 (lh 0.91, 0 to -0.01em), three to seven letters so it stays inside the 1344px content width. The h2 is the display face at 89px, mixed case (lh 1.0, max 900px, one to three lines). Then a straight jump to the sans: body 19-20px (-0.02em, lh 1.45, max 520px) and captions at 13px sentence case 500 at 65% ink. No h3 and no sub tier: the page skips the middle. Ratio about 16x, step ratio from poster to h2 about 3.6. Colour: ground a flat pale paper or one flat deep tone, ink the opposite pole, accent one flat second hue on a single button. Motion: the poster letters rise out of a mask 50ms apart (900ms); on scroll the poster drifts up at 0.85 of the scroll speed while the h2 reveals line by line.
phone: Poster word fitted to the width minus 40px, two stacked lines above five letters; h2 44px; body 17px; captions 13px.
houseRuleCheck: Capitals only on the one poster word, a content word never used as a name in the footer; captions are 13px sentence case.

name: Poster didone over a grotesque h2
description: A high-contrast didone at 400 in mixed case as a poster at 20vw over a neo-grotesque for the h2 and everything read. The poster is about 290px at 1440 (lh 1.0, -0.005em), one or two words of at most eight letters; at this size the fine strokes hold, and below 120px the display face appears only as a whole pull-quote line at 40px. Below the poster a sans h2 at 66px (500, lh 0.91, -0.03em, max 820px), h3 at 40px and body at 18px (lh 1.5, max 52 characters). Ratio about 16x from poster to body. No italics on words: italics only on a whole pull-quote line. Colour: ground a flat warm off-white or one deep tone, ink the opposite, accent one flat hue on the single action only. Motion: the poster word is revealed by a clip wipe from left to right (900ms, ease-out-expo); while it scrolls out it moves at 0.9 of the scroll speed and the h2 reveals line by line.
phone: Poster fitted to the width minus 40px (about 86px); h2 36px; h3 26px; body 17px.
houseRuleCheck: No italic or styled word inside a headline; italics only on a whole pull-quote line. The poster word is never a giant name in the footer.

name: Giant tight sans, two-tier jump
description: Faces: one neo-grotesque with only two real tiers. Display at 600 in mixed case, 13.9vw (200px at 1440, -0.05em, lh 1.0), one or two lines of at most 10 characters each, set from the left margin; one h2 at 80px (600, -0.04em, lh 1.0). Then straight down to text at 500 and 16-24px (-0.04em, lh 1.3), with no h3: sub heads are 24px text at full ink and body 16px at 70%. Step ratio 2.5 from display to h2, about 11x from display to 18px text. Colour: ground a flat tone, pale or deep, ink the opposite, accent one flat hue on the action fill and on one figure, never on a headline word. Motion: display lines slide up 110% out of masks (0.9s, ease-out-expo, 90ms apart); text blocks fade up 12px line by line as they enter.
phone: Display 15vw (about 58px) on up to three lines; h2 40px; text 17px at -0.03em.
houseRuleCheck: Clean.

name: Mixed-case display, caps sub-heads
description: Faces: one grotesque at weight 500 with the hierarchy turned round: the biggest type is in mixed case and the middle heads are capitals. Display in mixed case at 13.9vw (200px at 1440, lh 0.9) and a second step at 100px, at most 10 characters a line. Sub heads in capitals at 51px (h2) and 41px (h3), lh 1.0, untracked, max 720px and at most three lines. Body 24px (400, lh 1.5, max 46 characters), small text 15px sentence case 500. Step ratio about 2, whole ratio about 8x. Colour: ground a flat tone, ink the opposite, accent one flat hue on the action fill. Motion: display lines rise out of masks (80ms apart, 800ms); the capitals sub heads stand at 40% ink and ramp to full ink as they cross the middle of the viewport, scrubbed by scroll.
phone: Display 58px, second step 44px, caps sub heads 28px and 24px, body 18px.
houseRuleCheck: No monospace and no small caps labels: small text is 15px sentence case; capitals only for the 41-51px sub heads. One family only, so no serif accent face.

name: Grotesque display, bold second voice
description: Faces: one grotesque at 400-500 sets the display and the body; a stronger cut of the same family is the second voice. Display in mixed case at 6.4-6.7vw (92-96px at 1440), leading 0.95-1.1; heads at 62 / 54 / 32-40px; body 18-20px at leading 1.45. The second voice (weight 600-700, or the family's wide sibling) carries buttons, tags, navigation and card titles, and so a large share of the short text: 15-17px in sentence case with no tracking, set on accent-filled tags and card headers. Ratio 4.6-5.3x. Colour: ground neutral, ink one step off full contrast, the accent as the card and tag fills in which the second voice sits. Motion: tags slide in 40ms apart from the left; hover inverts a tag's fill and ink in 160ms.
phone: Display 11vw (42-44px); second voice 15px; tags wrap to two columns; card headers keep the bold voice.
houseRuleCheck: The second voice is 15-17px sentence case: never a small caps label and never a line above a heading.

name: Hairline didone ladder
description: A thin (200) didone display ladder in mixed case, 13vw at the top, over a grotesque for body and labels. The ladder is close and tight: 190px at 1440 (lh 0.8), then 104px, 96px and 72px (lh 0.8-0.9), each line at most 12 characters, max 1100px; below 72px the display face is not used. Body 16px (lh 1.6, max 52 characters), labels 16px sentence case 500. Ratio about 12x. Thin strokes need contrast to survive: a pale ground with ink one step off full black, or a deep ground with near-white ink, never grey ink; accent one flat hue on the action fill only. Motion: letters set in with an opacity fade, 35ms apart, 900ms, no blur, no scale; each ladder line leads the next by 120ms.
phone: 13vw becomes 52px minimum; the 72px step becomes 38px at weight 300 below 480px; body 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Clean.

name: Hand-lettered caps over rounded text
description: A hand-lettered condensed display face in capitals, set as live text and never as a drawn graphic, over a rounded sans for reading. Heads at 50px for sections and 34px for cards at 1440 (lh 1.0, untracked), plus one optional hero step at 72px on at most three lines of 18 characters. Reading text in the rounded sans: body 18px (lh 1.45, 400, max 52 characters), lead 20px, small text 15px at 500, sentence case. Ratio about 2.8x for the heads, up to 4x with the hero step. Colour: ground a flat warm cream or a flat soft tint, ink a warm dark brown, accent one bright flat hue on the action fill and on figures. Motion: heads pop in with a scale of 0.96 to 1 and a small back-out overshoot, 60ms apart per line (500ms); hovering a card tilts its head -1.5 degrees and returns (200ms).
phone: Hero 44px, heads 34px and 26px, body 17px; heads wrap to at most three lines.
houseRuleCheck: The lettered face is a font set as live text, not a drawn shape or illustration; small text is sentence case.

name: Heavy extended display, plain grotesk text
description: An extended grotesque at its heaviest weight (850 on a variable axis, otherwise 800) in mixed case for the display only over a plain grotesque at 400 for everything else. Display 72px (5vw at 1440, lh 1.0, -0.01em, one to three lines of at most 18 characters), sub heads at 33px and 24px. Body 16px (lh 1.5, max 52 characters), small text 14px sentence case. Ratio about 4.5x. The width and the weight give the voice; the text face stays quiet. Colour: ground a flat tone, ink the opposite, accent one flat saturated hue for the action fill and one figure. Motion: if the face is variable, a head eases from weight 600 to 850 as it enters (600ms), otherwise it rises out of a mask; link hover fades to the accent in 160ms.
phone: Display 38px, sub heads 26px and 22px, body 16px; extended heads wrap early, at most four lines.
houseRuleCheck: Clean.

name: Large-body single neo-grotesk
description: One neo-grotesque at 400 and everything big: display 97px at 1440 (6.8vw), h3 52px, h4 37px and a large body of 30px, mixed case, tracking -0.02em, headings at lh 1.1 and the body at lh 1.2. The only small tier is 16px sentence case 500 (lh 1.3) for buttons and captions. Ratio about 3.3x, so contrast comes from ink and space, not size: heads at full ink, body 60%. A 30px body means at most 44 characters a line and at most three lines a paragraph, so the page carries few words. Colour: ground a flat pale or deep tone, ink the opposite, accent one flat hue on the action fill. Motion: paragraph lines fade up 8px one after another (40ms apart, 600ms); hovering a link row lifts its ink from 60% to full (160ms).
phone: Display 48px, h3 34px, h4 28px, body 22px at lh 1.2; captions 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Labels are 16px sentence case, never small capitals.

name: Light caps display, plain small text
description: Faces: one neo-grotesque with a real light cut (200-300; 100 only if it stays legible at 108px and up). Display in caps at 7.5-10vw (108-144px at 1440), weight 200-300, leading 0.9-1.0, tracking 0 to +0.01em, one or two lines. Nothing sits between the display and the small text, so no mid headings. Text, navigation and buttons are the same sans in sentence case at 16px, weight 400, leading 1.5. Ratio 7-9x. Light strokes thin out on screen, so set the ink one step softer than full contrast on a dark ground and never paler than the display on a pale one. Colour: ground deep graphite or pale grey-white; one warm or cool accent on the button only. Motion: the display fades in during 700ms while its tracking settles from +0.04em to 0; hover brightens ink.
phone: Display 10-11vw (40-44px), weight stepped up to 300 so strokes hold; text 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Only the display is in capitals; text, navigation and buttons are 16px sentence case.

name: Light flared serif, very tight
description: A light (300) flared serif (stroke ends widen slightly, a chiselled feel) in mixed case for the display over a grotesque for body and small text. Display 8vw at 1440 (117px) and one step at 60px, tracked very tight at -0.07em, lh 1.0, one to three lines of at most 16 characters. Body at 19-21px tracked -0.04em (never smaller than 18px at this tightness), lh 1.4, max 48 characters; small text 14px sentence case 500 at -0.01em, since small type is not tightened. Ratio about 5.6x. No italics on words and no capitals. Colour: ground a flat warm paper tone or a deep ground, ink the opposite, accent one flat hue on the action fill. Motion: the display pulls together as it arrives: tracking eases from -0.02em to -0.07em in 1.1s (ease-out-expo) while the line fades in; the 60px step follows 150ms later.
phone: Display 52px and 36px at -0.05em; body 17px at -0.02em; at most four lines.
houseRuleCheck: No italic accent words and no small caps labels: small text is 14px sentence case.

name: Wide grotesque, flat scale
description: A wide grotesque with crisp, squared terminals at 500-700 for headings over a regular grotesque for text. The display is only 2.5-2.8vw (36-40px at 1440), leading 0.9-1.2, tracking -0.02em, mixed case, and the other steps sit close: 33 / 30 / 26 / 20px, with text at 16px, leading 1.5. Ratio about 2.5x. The scale is flat: rank comes from filled cards, ground colour and weight, not from size. Lines run 52-60 characters, text on five or six of the twelve columns. A small display cannot fill the first screen, so the hero carries a large picture or window with the headline beside it or on a quiet area of it. Colour: ground pale neutral or dark graphite, ink one step off full contrast, accent as card fills and the button. Motion: headings step in with a 12px rise; card hover lifts the fill toward the accent.
phone: Display 26-28px, steps 24 / 22 / 20, text 16px; cards stack.
houseRuleCheck: A page only of boxes is banned: deal it with a picture or window section between the card sections.

name: Neo display with a script voice
description: Faces: one neo-grotesque at 400 in mixed case with a huge display, and one connected script as a human voice for short notes. Display 12.8vw at 1440 (184px, lh 1.0, -0.02em, one or two lines of at most 10 characters), a second display at 155px, a capitals h1 at 94px, and heads at 43px, 36px and 25px (lh 1.1). Reading text 18px (lh 1.5, max 52 characters), small text 15px sentence case 500. The script (brush or pen lettering as live text) sets a single short note at 28px, lh 1.1, at most twice on the page, never inside a headline and never as body. Ratio about 10x. Colour: ground a flat tone, ink the opposite, the accent for the script note (contrast at least 4.5:1) and the action fill. Motion: display lines rise out of masks (80ms apart, 800ms); a script note is revealed by a left-to-right mask wipe (700ms) as if written.
phone: Display 58px, second display 48px, h1 34px, heads 30px and 24px, script note 24px.
houseRuleCheck: No monospace labels; the script is a standalone note, at most twice per page, never a styled word in a headline.

name: Old-style heads, extended wayfinding face
description: An old-style serif (soft stress, calligraphic feel) at 400 in mixed case for headings over a neo-grotesque at 400 for reading, with an extended grotesque for wayfinding. Headings 93px at 1440 (6.5vw, lh 1.0, max 900px, at most three lines) and 53px. Reading text 17.5px, lh 1.5, max 52 characters. The extended face sets the menu links at 33px (lh 1.0, sentence case, in a full-screen menu list) and small text and labels at 15px sentence case 500 (+0.02em). Ratio about 5.3x. Colour: ground a flat paper or a deep tone, ink the opposite, accent one flat hue on the action fill and on the menu hover. Motion: hovering one menu link dims its siblings to 40% ink while it holds full ink (180ms); headings rise out of masks line by line (70ms apart, 800ms).
phone: Headings 46px and 32px, body 17px, menu links 28px, labels 15px.
houseRuleCheck: Labels are 15px sentence case, never small tracked capitals.

name: Rounded bold system
description: One rounded sans (rounded terminals) for everything, no decorative face. Display 700 at 4.4vw at 1440 (64px, lh 1.15, -0.01em, one to three lines of at most 22 characters), then 48px and 32px (lh 1.375), a 19px sub head, body 17px 400 (lh 1.41, max 56 characters) and buttons at 16px 700 in sentence case. Ratio about 3.8x. Colour: ground a flat white or a soft flat tint, ink a deep warm tone, accent a bright flat hue (green, orange, blue) on button fills and on figures. Motion: heads pop in with a scale from 0.96 and a back-out overshoot (500ms, 60ms apart per line); hovering a button lifts it 2px with a transform (120ms), with no shadow.
phone: Display 40px, 32px and 26px steps, body 17px, buttons full width at 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Controls are 16px sentence case bold, never tracked small capitals.

name: Screen-filling condensed caps
description: A condensed grotesque in capitals as the only display face, enormous at 30vw, over a neo-grotesque for one statement and the plain text. The word is three to seven letters at 432px at 1440 (lh 0.8), kept inside the 1344px content width; real figures the page states (a year, a price, a quantity) at 21vw (302px); a ladder at 140px, 100px and 40px (lh 0.8-0.9). Between the display and the text, one statement in the sans at 60px (-0.04em, lh 1.0, max 760px), then plain text at 20px (lh 1.45, max 52 characters). Ratio about 22x. Colour: ground a flat saturated hue or a deep neutral, ink white or near-black as needed, accent one flat second hue on the action. Motion: the word rises out of a mask (1s, ease-out-expo) and, while its section scrolls, slides sideways by up to 4vw against the scroll direction without ever leaving the margins.
phone: Word fitted to the width minus 40px, stacked on two lines past five letters; figures 20vw; ladder 64/48/28px; statement 32px; text 17px.
houseRuleCheck: Figures are real statements (a year, a price), never 01/02/03 numbering or a counter; the word stays inside the page margins and is never a name or email in the footer.

name: One serif for display and reading
description: Faces: one transitional serif sets the display and the reading text; a neo-grotesque appears only in small interface text. Display at 5vw in mixed case (72px at 1440, lh 1.0, -0.03em, at most 20 characters a line), h2 54px, and a large reading body at 30px (lh 1.2, max 44 characters, at most four lines a paragraph). Buttons, captions and navigation in the sans at 14px sentence case 500. Ratio about 2.4x. No italic on words: italics only for a whole pull quote or an attribution line. Colour: ground a flat paper tone or a deep tone, ink the opposite, accent one flat hue on the action fill. Motion: the reading paragraph's ink ramps word by word from 30% to full as it crosses the viewport (scrubbed by scroll, across 120% of the viewport height).
phone: Display 40px, h2 34px, body 22px at lh 1.25, small text 14px.
houseRuleCheck: No italic accent words; small interface text is 14px sentence case.

name: Serif and sans at one display size
description: A didone at regular weight in mixed case for alternate display lines over a neo-grotesque that sets the other lines at the same 7vw size and all the reading text. Display about 100px at 1440 (lh 0.95, -0.025em). The two faces take whole lines, never single words: a headline is two or three stacked lines, line one in the display face, line two in the sans, line three in the display face; scale the sans down about 4% so the x-heights match and the lines read as one size. For a harder contrast the sans line may go to 700 against the display face at 100-200. No italics. Body in the sans at 17px (lh 1.5, max 52 characters), small text 14px sentence case 500. Ratio about 6x. Colour: one flat ground, one ink for all lines, accent one flat hue on the action only. Motion: lines rise out of masks, the second line 120ms after the first (800ms).
phone: Both faces 11vw (about 43px), alternating by line; body 17px.
houseRuleCheck: The faces alternate by whole line, never a single styled word inside a line; no italics.

name: Single bold headline step
description: A scene-level type note with exactly one step: a bold (700) humanist or grotesque sans headline at 6.7vw at 1440 (96px, lh 1.15, -0.01em), two to four lines of at most 22 characters, max 1000px, left or centred. There is no body tier on the screen: the scene carries the headline and at most one 16px action. Use the page's chosen display face at 700, never a default system face. Colour: the ground is the scene (a film frame or a flat tone), the ink is the pole that reads on it, and no accent. Motion: the headline's words ramp from 20% to full ink one after another (40ms apart in time, or scrubbed across the pin if the scene is pinned).
phone: 40px at lh 1.15, at most five lines of 14 characters; one 16px action above the safe area.
houseRuleCheck: Use the page's own display face, never a default system face; no label above the headline.

name: One book serif, flat scale
description: Faces: one book serif (transitional or old-style) at 400 with a true italic kept for quotes. The top step is only 40-56px (2.75-3.9vw at 1440), leading 1.0-1.1, tracking -0.01em; then 44 / 32 / 24px, body 18px at leading 1.5, small 14px. Ratio 1.5-2.8x. Almost no size contrast, so rank comes from space, position and card fills; headings in sentence or title case. A small sans at 14px in sentence case for captions is optional. It reads like a printed book, so the hero needs a large picture to fill the first screen. Colour: ground warm paper or deep olive-ink, ink soft black, one earthy accent on the button and card fill. Motion: paragraphs reveal in chunks of two or three lines; hover darkens ink.
phone: Top step 32-34px, body 18px at leading 1.5, nothing below 14px.
houseRuleCheck: Italics only for whole quotes, never for a word in a headline.

name: Light neo-grotesque poster, big body
description: Faces: one light (300) neo-grotesque for everything, tracked tight, with a big body. Display at 10-17.4vw (144-250px at 1440, -0.05 to -0.07em, lh 0.84-0.9): at 17vw one word of up to nine letters on one line, kept inside the 1344px content width; at 10vw a line of two or three words. The h2 at 7-10vw (101-144px, same tracking, lh 0.95, at most two lines), a 38px sub where needed, body 24-26px (lh 1.33, max 48 characters), a 19px secondary and small text 15px sentence case. Ratio 6-10x. Ink strength carries the rest of the hierarchy: display full, body 70%. Colour: ground a flat pale or deep tone, ink the opposite, accent one flat hue on the action fill. Motion: the display drifts up at 0.7 of the scroll speed and fades to zero by 80% of its section; the h2 reveals line by line out of masks (80ms apart, 800ms); hovering a link washes a flat ink fill at 12% behind it in 160ms.
phone: One poster word fitted to the width minus 40px (about 22vw, 86px; two lines past six letters), or a 52px line at -0.05em; h2 40-55px; body 19-20px.
houseRuleCheck: The poster word is a content word inside the page margins, never a name or email in the footer; no monospace labels.

name: Compact single neo-grotesque
description: Faces: one neo-grotesque, mostly 400 (the display may go to 600). Top step 52-60px (3.6-4.2vw at 1440), leading 1.0-1.05, tracking -0.02em, mixed case; then 36 / 24 / 16 / 14px. Ratio 3.2-3.8x, with no separate label voice: labels are the body face at 14px, weight 500, sentence case. Compact and exact, made for software and product pages. A 56px headline does not fill a first screen alone, so pair it with a large product window or picture. Colour: ground white or graphite, ink one step off full contrast, one saturated mid-tone accent on the button, the active tab and a card tint. Motion: headline lines fade up 100ms apart; tab and button hovers shift the fill.
phone: Top step 34-38px, steps 26 / 20 / 16, labels 14px.
houseRuleCheck: Clean.

name: One medium sans, mid ratio
description: Faces: one neo-grotesque or geometric-leaning sans family at 400, 500 and 600 does every job. Display in mixed case at weight 400-500, clamp(56px, 7.5vw, 120px), about 108px at 1440, leading 0.95-1.05, two or three lines on a 9-10 column measure; tracking -0.01 to -0.03em at 500, or tightened to -0.05em at 400 for a sharper, exact voice. A five-step ladder runs 108 / 64 / 40 / 24 / 17px, with a 20-22px lead where a section needs one; body 17px at leading 1.5. Small text, buttons and tags are the body face at 14-15px, weight 500, sentence case. Emphasis comes only from weight 600 on a sub-head. Colour: ground a quiet off-white or deep neutral, ink one step off full contrast, one accent kept for the primary button, active states and a card fill, never for a headline word. Motion: the headline rises line by line out of a mask, 70ms apart; links change colour on hover. It is the calm default: the type stays out of the way of the pictures and cards.
phone: Display 11-12vw (44-48px) at leading 1.05; ladder 44 / 30 / 22 / 17; same weights; one column with a measure of 32-36 characters.
houseRuleCheck: Clean.

name: Small serif heads, grotesk body
description: A transitional serif at 400 for a few small headings over a grotesque at 400/500 that carries 95% of the text, in a shop-like system. The display face sets category and section heads at 40px at most (2.8vw at 1440) and 18px (lh 1.2). Body 16px (lh 1.5); navigation and labels 14px 500 sentence case; product names and prices 16px 500. Ratio about 2.5x, step ratio about 1.13: a quiet page where the pictures are the loud part. Colour: ground a flat soft tone, ink the opposite, accent one flat hue on the single action. Motion: no type animation beyond heads fading in during 400ms as they enter; a card's name changes ink on hover (160ms).
phone: Serif 30px and 18px, body 16px, labels 14px; grid of two columns.
houseRuleCheck: Grouping comes from filled product cards; no capitals and nothing below 14px.

name: Thin serif heads over a light sans
description: A thin flared serif (stroke ends widen slightly) on every heading step over a light-to-regular grotesque for the body. Heads at 86px (6vw at 1440) and 52px at weight 100-200, then 32px and 22px at weight 200 so the strokes stay visible; lh 1.0 at the top easing to 1.25 at 22px, no tracking, at most 20 characters a line. A sharper, more upright cut works as well as a flared one; for a quieter page only the top step keeps the display face, at 80px and lh 1.2, and the lower heads move to the sans. Body at 16-18px (lh 1.4-1.55, max 52 characters), small text and labels 15px sentence case 500. Italics only for a whole quote. Ratio about 5x. Thin strokes need the strongest contrast on the page: ink at full strength on a flat pale or deep ground, never grey; accent one flat hue on the action fill. Motion: heading words rise 24px and fade in, 55ms apart per word (800ms); no scroll motion on the type.
phone: Heads 50 / 36 / 26 / 21px all at weight 200 (or one 40px step at 300 when only the top step keeps the display face); body 16-17px.
houseRuleCheck: Italics only on whole quotes, never on words in headings; labels are 15px sentence case, never tracked capitals.

name: Tight sans with serif figures
description: A neo-grotesque at 500 for all words, display at 11.7vw, over a transitional serif used only for figures. The display is 168px at 1440 (-0.04em), one line of a word without descenders so a leading of 0.7 does not collide; at two lines, leading 0.85. Steps at 54px, 30px, 24px and 18px (lh 1.1-1.4); body 16-18px. Figures in the serif at 72px (lh 1.0): real numbers the page states, such as a price, a year or a quantity. Ratio about 9x from the display to the 18px step. Colour: ground a flat tone, ink the opposite, accent one flat hue on the action fill; the figures take the ink, not the accent. Motion: the display rises out of a mask (900ms); figures fade in without counting.
phone: Display 58px at lh 0.85, steps 40/26/22/17px, figures 48px.
houseRuleCheck: Figures are real numbers the page states, never 01/02/03 numbering or a count-up counter.

name: Tight transitional serif ladder
description: A transitional serif at 400 on a close heading ladder over a neo-grotesque at 500 for text. Top head 84px (5.8vw at 1440, lh 0.9, -0.02em), section heads 63px and 58px, card heads 42px and small heads 21px (lh 1.0-1.2). Text 16px (lh 1.45, max 52 characters), and one stat figure at 47px in the sans, a real number the page states. Ratio about 5x from top head to text. Because the steps sit close, the hierarchy is carried by position and by filled cards that group the content. Colour: ground a flat paper or a deep tone, ink the opposite, accent one flat hue on the action fill. Motion: the top head reveals line by line out of masks (70ms apart, 800ms); hovering a card head swaps its ink to the accent (160ms).
phone: Heads 44/36/34/28/20px, text 16px, figure 38px.
houseRuleCheck: The figure is a real stat, never 01/02/03 numbering.

name: Two-size quiet sans
description: Faces: one neo-grotesque at 400 in mixed case at two small sizes only, with no display tier. Text at 16px (lh 1.25, max 46 characters) and credits and captions at 13px (lh 1.25) at 55% ink; nothing smaller. The hierarchy comes from outside the type: pictures at 40% of the viewport or more, 160px or more of space between groups, and ink strength (full and 55%). The first screen is one full-bleed picture with a single two-line statement in the 16px text set on its quietest area, with no box behind it. Colour: ground a flat pale or deep tone, ink the opposite, accent none or one flat hue on the single action. Motion: lines of text fade in 6px lower and settle (500ms, 40ms apart); hovering a text row fills it with the ink and swaps its letters to the ground colour in a 28px-high chip (160ms).
phone: Same 16px and 13px; pictures full width; one text group per screen.
houseRuleCheck: Nothing under 13px and nothing in capitals; the picture is never a documentary photograph, and the statement sits on its own quiet area, not on a box.

name: Flat compact sans, one weight
description: Faces: one neo-grotesque at one weight (500), with a deliberately flat scale. Headline at 36-44px in mixed case (lh 0.92, -0.02 to -0.05em, max 520px, up to three lines of 22 characters) and body at 16px (lh 1.35, max 52 characters, at most three lines a block); a longer page may add one 30-33px step and a 20px lead, never more. Ratio about 2.2-2.7x. Hierarchy comes from ink (headline full, body 60%) and from placement, and the page groups its content in a few filled cards (fills, no outlines) so the flat type still reads in clear groups. A headline this small does not fill a first screen, so the hero is a full-screen picture or product window with the headline beside it or on a quiet area of it. Colour: ground a flat pale or deep tone, card fills one step off the ground, ink the opposite, accent one flat hue on the action. Motion: type stays still; cards fade up 12px as they enter (500ms, 70ms apart); hovering a card swaps its fill one step (160ms).
phone: Headline 30px at lh 0.95, body 16px, cards full width.
houseRuleCheck: Cards are filled, never outlined, and the page is not boxes only: deal it with a picture or window between the card groups.

name: Very tight sans, graduated ladder
description: Faces: one medium (400-500) sans with tracking of -0.04 to -0.06em on every display step, even the 33px one; body stays near -0.01 to -0.02em for reading. Six steps from 10-12vw (144-175px at 1440, leading 0.8-0.95) through 107 / 80 / 53 / 33px, then 17px body, all in mixed case. Ratio 7-13x. The signature is the tracking, and the steps are graduated: hero 144-175px, section titles 80-107px, card titles 33-53px. Colour: ground flat neutral or deep tone, ink at full contrast, accent for card and button fills only. Motion: tracking loosens from -0.08em to its set value as each headline enters, in 500ms, and the same loosening runs on link hover.
phone: Ladder times 0.4 (60 / 44 / 32 / 24 / 20); tracking held at -0.04em, since more makes letters collide.
houseRuleCheck: Clean.

name: Wide-tracked geometric caps
description: Faces: one geometric sans in capitals with open tracking on the display only. Display light (300) in capitals at 4.3vw at 1440 (62px, +0.32em, lh 1.3, one or two lines of at most 14 characters, centred or left); heads in capitals at 50px and 40px, +0.045em, lh 1.4. A 20px capitals lead at +0.045em, then a sentence-case 24px h4 and body 16px (lh 1.6, max 52 characters). Tracking is used only at 20px and above; labels and small text are 16px sentence case, so nothing small is spaced out. Ratio about 3.9x. Colour: ground a flat pale or deep tone, ink the opposite, accent one flat hue on the action fill. Motion: the display opens like a breath: letters fade in while the tracking eases from +0.16em to +0.32em in 1.2s (ease-out-expo).
phone: Display 30px at +0.2em; heads 28px and 24px at +0.03em; lead 17px; body 16px.
houseRuleCheck: Tracked capitals only at 20px and up; every small tier is sentence case, so no letter-spaced labels.
